scope: architecture-transfer comparison on seven PR43 supported synthetic materials; not a source-faithful Bin Cao replication

primary.reused_split: PR43 runs/pilot_20261019 split_manifest.json, same parent q and same-generator test; already opened in PR43
primary.test_role: previously opened exploratory architecture-transfer extension; not independent confirmation

resnet1d.stem: Conv1d 1->24 kernel9 stride4 padding4, GroupNorm(4), SiLU
resnet1d.blocks: two residual blocks at width24, then stride2 transition 24->48 and two residual blocks at width48; kernel5, GroupNorm(4), SiLU
resnet1d.head: Linear 48->ndim, Tanh

training.selection: lowest validation mean absolute q error; earliest epoch on tie
training.device: CUDA RTX 4060 Laptop GPU only; block if unavailable, occupied by confirmed compute, or less than 1 GiB free VRAM
training.inference_device: CPU, one spectrum at a time

smoke.role: operational GPU and checkpoint smoke only; no test profiles or performance inference; excluded from all comparison summaries

physics.bounds: the existing frozen PR43 q and eta bounds
physics.selection: lowest observed profile RMSE; record every start, including failures

stress.renderer: independent pymatgen XRDCalculator peaks, 0.7 Gaussian + 0.3 Lorentzian peaks and unmodelled quadratic background 0.03*xnorm^2; same PR43 stress observations, already opened for MLP
stress.role: previously opened exploratory independent-renderer mismatch extension; not independent confirmation

predeclared_interpretation.accuracy_rule: all three seeds beat P3 q-MAE by at least 5%; each cell-DOF MAE is no worse than 5%; convergence is no worse; show P5 alongside
predeclared_interpretation.runtime_rule: include measured training plus amortized inference plus refinement and compare against the stated physics budget
